characters.summary: Rolanda Hooch is the flying instructor and Quidditch referee at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. She fights and defends using a broomstick for extreme aerial mobility and wields a standard wand for magic.

sources.supports: Role as flying instructor, referee, and magical capabilities

campaignTags.claim: Flies expertly on a broomstick as Quidditch instructor

unknowns: Exact combat duel records are not documented in detail.

characters.summary: Poppy Pomfrey is the head nurse at Hogwarts Hospital Wing, highly skilled in magical healing, potions, and restorative charms. She relies on medical potions, bandages, and wand-based spells to treat injuries and ailments.

sources.supports: Medical expertise, healing spells, and potions at Hogwarts

campaignTags.claim: Expert magical healer capable of regrowing bones and curing severe curses
Treats students and staff with advanced healing magic and potions
Wand-wielding witch performing complex medical and protective spells

unknowns: Offensive combat capabilities outside of hospital care are not extensively documented.

characters.summary: Olympe Maxime is the half-giant headmistress of Beauxbatons Academy of Magic. She possesses immense physical strength due to her giant heritage combined with advanced wand magic.

sources.supports: Half-giant heritage, magic abilities, and role as Beauxbatons headmistress

campaignTags.claim: Half-giant standing significantly taller than ordinary humans
Capable witch and headmistress utilizing wand magic

unknowns: Full extent of dueling feats against major dark wizards is unrecorded.

characters.summary: Minerva McGonagall is the Deputy Headmistress of Hogwarts, Head of Gryffindor House, and a master Transfigurationist. She casts powerful spells, animates statues for defense, and transforms into a cat.

sources.supports: Transfiguration mastery, Animagus form, and duel feats

feats.claim: Animated the castle statues of Hogwarts to defend the school during the Battle of Hogwarts
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Fought Snape in the Great Hall until he fled.

campaignTags.claim: Master witch capable of high-level transfiguration and charm work

unknowns: Exact limits of her stamina during prolonged multi-opponent warfare are unquantified.

characters.summary: In her Animagus cat form, Minerva McGonagall retains her human intellect while taking the physical shape of a tabby cat with distinctive markings around her eyes. This form provides enhanced stealth and agility at the cost of human speech and wand use.
weaknesses: Inability to cast spells or speak while in animal form
characters.formDifferences: Changes human form into a tabby cat with square markings around the eyes, sacrificing speech and wand usage for feline agility and stealth.
unknowns: Durability limits against heavy magical attack while in cat form.

characters.summary: Moaning Myrtle is a Hogwarts ghost who haunts a girls' second-floor bathroom. As a ghost, she is immune to physical harm and can pass through solid objects, but she has very limited ability to physically interact with the living world.

mechanisms: Incorporeal ghost physiology (immunity to physical attacks)

weaknesses: Incorporeality prevents direct physical attack or lifting of heavy objects

sources.supports: Ghost nature, incorporeality, and haunting habits

unknowns: Capacity to influence physical combat is negligible.

characters.summary: Molly Weasley is a matriarch of the Weasley family and a capable witch affiliated with the Order of the Phoenix. She typically utilizes household utility magic and protective charms, but demonstrates lethal proficiency in combat when defending her family.

sources.supports: Combat skills during the Battle of Hogwarts and duel against Bellatrix Lestrange

feats.claim: Defeated and killed Bellatrix Lestrange during the Battle of Hogwarts
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Killed Bellatrix in a duel in the Great Hall after Bellatrix threatened Ginny Weasley.

campaignTags.claim: Capable witch skilled in combat and defensive magic

unknowns: Frequency of engagement in front-line combat outside of the final battle is low.

characters.summary: Nagini is a giant venomous snake and the loyal companion and Horcrux of Lord Voldemort. She attacks by biting with venomous fangs and obeys Voldemort's telepathic commands.

mechanisms: Horcrux magical protection (requires destruction by powerful magical artifacts like Gryffindor's sword)

weaknesses: Vulnerable to destruction by Basilisk venom or equivalent enchanted artifacts targeting Horcruxes

sources.supports: Venomous snake form, Horcrux status, and attacks on characters

feats.claim: Mauled Arthur Weasley at the Department of Mysteries
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Ambushed and severely injured Arthur Weasley while linked to Voldemort's vision.

unknowns: Full capabilities prior to becoming Voldemort's primary snake companion.

characters.summary: As a Maledictus, human Nagini carries a blood curse that destined her to permanently transform into a snake. In her human form, she possesses normal human physical capabilities combined with circus performer agility.
weaknesses: Inevitable permanent transformation into a snake due to the blood curse
characters.formDifferences: Changes the giant snake into a human woman cursed to eventually become a beast permanently, utilizing human agility and physical combat rather than venomous bites.

sources.supports: Maledictus blood curse and human form details in Fantastic Beasts

unknowns: Extent of defensive magic or combat training before joining the circus.

characters.summary: Narcissa Malfoy is a pure-blood witch of high society and a member of the House of Black. While she rarely engages in direct frontline dueling, she wields a wand and relies on elite social influence, defensive magic, and deception.

sources.supports: Wand usage, familial ties, and role in the Second Wizarding War

feats.claim: Examined Harry Potter in the Forbidden Forest and falsely declared him dead to Voldemort
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

campaignTags.claim: Pure-blood witch capable of casting spells and performing the Unbreakable Vow

unknowns: Direct combat dueling performance record is minimal.
